Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
spinney99 wrote:
>
> my guess is that if Saxum changes to a ventrue via Clan Impersonation,

Correct.

> most things
> work that way, but assamites lose the blood curse if they CI any other
> clan. i think this is because it's actually listed in the rulebook
> (6.5.5) that the condition is clan-based.

Correct.

> and many times, the
> bloodlines Additional Rules for VTES implies that only gargoyles can
> be slaves (3.9) making that condition clan-based as well. And the
> question... UH... howzitgo?

Only Gargoyles get to interpose for their masters.
But slave vampires are limited to undirected action without their masters.
Per BL 3.9
